from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background}

    # The connected non-background exemplar is the stamp; isolated pixels are
    # its targets. (ARC examples use a connected multicolor stamp.)
    components = []
    unseen = set(active)
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = deque([start])
        while q:
            r, c = q.popleft()
            for p in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    q.append(p)
        components.append(comp)
    stamp = max(components, key=len)
    targets = [p for comp in components if comp is not stamp for p in comp]
    if not targets:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    r0 = min(r for r, c in stamp); r1 = max(r for r, c in stamp)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in stamp); c1 = max(c for r, c in stamp)
    ar, ac = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    stencil = [(r-ar, c-ac, grid[r][c])
               for r in range(r0, r1+1) for c in range(c0, c1+1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for tr, tc in targets:
        for dr, dc, color in stencil:
            rr, cc = tr+dr, tc+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
